summary: The First Den is a forest home base at the spawn clearing: a three-storey cob house, lake grounds and authored camp/door details sit in terrain shaped by winding rivers and procedural woodland. The main place now also lays long east- and westbound cobbled routes toward Lumenvale and Hearthmere, with authored bridges, waylamps, milestones and rest stops; player movement includes a double-tap flight toggle.
places: places/main - sole live place; forest-terrain heightmap/materials, river and road marks, procedural forest scatter, and authored house/grounds plus distant road cells
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - spawn clearing and active cob-house/home grounds, square-door assembly, camp, garden, signpost, ambience and dragon blueprint placeholder
places/main/cells/ - authored road corridor cells: bridges, lamps, milestones and one roadside rest area; x-1z0.scene also carries the river-sound emitter
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry for default place main, multiplayer, player/camera, lighting, input, arrival and UI hooks
templates/player.js#player - character root with movement, humanoid locomotion and home interaction behaviors
templates/camera.js#camera - custom first-person camera driven by look orientation
places/main/config.yaml - terrain, spawn/gravity, river/road/clearing/home marks and forest decoration layers
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#cob-house - active three-storey cob home generator at the cleared home site
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#square-door - authored square portal/door assembly and passage behavior
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#road-signpost - authored arms label routes to Lumenvale, Hearthmere and Home
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#jade-dragon - blueprint box, not the articulated dragon actor
shared: scripts/forest-terrain.js - main place heightAt/materialAt terrain contract, including river channels and material bands
scripts/gen/forest-plant.js + scripts/gen/valley-mesh.js - procedural vegetation geometry used by forest decoration layers
scripts/lib/road-solid.js - outward-wound solid/face helpers shared by road bridge and road dressing generators
scripts/lib/dragon-rider.js + scripts/lib/data/dragon.js - conditional rider handoff and shared dragon tuning used by player feel/camera/dragon integrations
scripts/lib/home-interaction.js + scripts/lib/data/home-feel.js - shared interaction targeting and tuning for home/player interactions
scripts/lib/data/player.yml - movement, turning and flight tuning consumed by scripts/player.js
scripts/lib/data/camera.yml - first-person camera tuning consumed by scripts/camera.js
notableExports: scripts/forest-terrain.js - exports GROUND, SITES, LAKE, heightAt(ctx), materialAt(ctx)
scripts/gen/road-dressing.js - exports geometry(ctx), collider(ctx) for lamp, milestone, bench, well, signpost arm
scripts/lib/road-solid.js - exports Q, T, solid, prism, box, ngon, gem
scripts/jade-dragon.js - exports ears, onSpawn, onControlEnd, onInput, update; still conditional, no active actor row
ownership: places/main/config.yaml + scripts/forest-terrain.js - configured terrain generator/seed/materials and derived terrain height/material selection
places/main/config.yaml - owns forest scatter and terrain marks, including road corridors, home site and spawn clearing
places/main/cells/*.scene - own authored scene row ids, placements, transforms, tags and row state; includes active cob-house and authored roadside features

scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - own player movement/velocity/jump and flying toggle; per-body last-jump/flying scratch is in ctx.session, flying indicator is mirrored to player state
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - owns player yaw and gait channels; scripts/camera.js owns local camera placement/view and local-player hiding
scripts/road-rest.js - reads each rest row's state.say/state.sound on press and emits text/audio; cell state supplies the content
scripts/jade-dragon.js - if attached to a live actor, owns its mode/rider and flight/landing state; current scene has no such actor
flows: places/main/config.yaml terrain.generator + seed -> scripts/forest-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt(ctx) -> engine terrain and forest/river material bands
places/main/config.yaml forest decoration layers -> scripts/gen/forest-plant.js and scripts/gen/valley-tree.js -> seeded forest vegetation variants
places/main/config.yaml road marks -> terrain cobble corridors and cleared scatter edges; authored road cell rows add bridges and roadside dressing along east/west routes
moveX/moveZ + camera aim input -> scripts/player.js -> movement intent, velocity and jump; place gravity applies to character body
jump presses -> scripts/player.js + player.yml flyTapWindow -> double-tap flying toggle, player.state.flying and lift/descend sound; while flying, space/shift control climb
move/look input -> scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js -> player yaw and gait channels
player body -> scripts/camera.js -> first-person eye/view; a controlled dragon conditionally uses DRAGON.seatEye
interact input -> scripts/home-player-feel.js + scripts/lib/home-interaction.js -> nearest in-range/look-aligned interactable press; dragon tags conditionally request mount via dragon-rider.js
road-rest row press -> scripts/road-rest.js -> emits row state.say as damage-number text and optionally plays state.sound
square-door approach/passage triggers -> scripts/square-door.js -> portal link/door transition; authored frame/sign rows provide the assembly
forest-ambience and x-1z0.scene river-sound rows -> spatial/non-spatial Ambience audio playback
dragon actor mode -> dragon clips/UI conditional integrations; no live dragon behavior row currently receives this flow
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/forest-plant.js + scripts/gen/valley-mesh.js - procedural forest plant kit reused for broadleaf trees, saplings, shrubs, ferns, reeds and logs, varied by kind/dimensions/seed
places/main/config.yaml decoration layers - multi-scale scatter varied by material binding, density, terrain constraints, seed, wind and range; some layers use valley-tree.js
scripts/gen/cob-house.js - one authored procedural hexagonal three-storey cob-house geometry/collider, configured as the active spawn home
scripts/gen/road-bridge.js + scripts/lib/road-solid.js - pale-stone/timber bridge geometry and collider reused for road crossings, varied by length, width and seed

scripts/gen/road-dressing.js + scripts/lib/road-solid.js - shared roadside geometry/collider builders varied by kind, hue, direction and length; placed as lamps, milestones, rest furnishings and sign arms
scripts/player.js + scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/home-player-feel.js - player movement, gait, interaction and conditional rider integration attached through templates/player.js
scripts/jade-dragon.js + scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js + scripts/lib/dragon-clips.js - retained articulated rideable dragon family; scene dragon is only a blueprint placeholder
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-terrain.js - no current place config selects it; main uses scripts/forest-terrain.js
scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js - no current scene/template references its geometry; current dragon row is a blueprint box
scripts/jade-dragon.js - no current scene row attaches the actor behavior; player/camera/UI retain conditional integration only
migrationNotes: forest-terrain.js takes a context object for heightAt/materialAt; main uses river sea level y=0, ground around y=0.5 and a spawn clearing centered at (0,-3), height 0.5.

places/main/config.yaml decoration layers depend on terrain material ids litter, moss, mud and pebbles; preserve layer bindings and terrain return ids together. Road marks additionally use cobble and litter edges.
The cob-house is now active at (0, 0.5, -26); homeSite/homeClear terrain marks and its placement must remain aligned. The previous cleared-scene note is obsolete.

Road terrain marks and authored bridge/dressing cells are coordinated across long routes; bridge origins are at road level y=0.5, length runs along local Z, and road-solid winding controls face orientation.
scripts/player.js keeps flight toggle scratch in ctx.session per body to avoid per-tick replicated writes; player.state.flying mirrors the toggle, and flyTapWindow is in milliseconds.
The jade-dragon row remains a blueprint box rather than the authored articulated actor; dragon camera/player/UI integrations remain conditional.
